/** * RankedChart -- Lead Panel Chart view. * * CTO synthesis (s.3) describes this as "time series of the selected metric, top * names overlaid." A multi-day trend * line has no second point to draw yet, so this renders the one snapshot honestly as * a bar-per-ticker chart (current rank/score, top names) rather than fabricating a * time axis with one sample. The X axis becomes a real time series the day a second * `as_of_date` lands -- the data shape (`RankingRow.as_of_date`) already supports it; * nothing here re-derives a score, only bins what the producer wrote. * * Dark-container-only (white idiom) -- rendered inside `LeadPanel`'s * `Panel variant="mixed"` body (recharts' own SVG text uses an explicit fill, not a * Tailwind text-white class, so it is set per-element below). */ import { type FC } from 'react' import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from 'recharts' import type { RankingRow } from '../types' export interface RankedChartProps { rows: RankingRow[] isLoading?: boolean } const AXIS_TEXT_FILL = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' const GRID_STROKE = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' const BAR_FILL = 'hsl(var(--semantic-action-primary))' export const RankedChart: FC = ({ rows, isLoading }) => { if (isLoading) { return
Loading chart…
} if (rows.length === 0) { return
No ranked names for this axis yet.
} const asOfDate = rows[0]?.as_of_date const chartData = rows.map((row) => ({ ticker: row.ticker, score: row.score, rank: row.rank, })) return (
Snapshot as of {asOfDate} -- one day landed so far; becomes a true time series once a second daily run lands.
) }
